results.snippet:
No. In April 2026 Render replaced its per-member plans with flat workspace fees: Pro ($25/month flat) replaced Professional ($19 per member per month), and Scale ($499/month flat) replaced Organization ($29 per member per month), per Render's changelog. Pro and Scale include unlimited seats. Hobby stays at one seat, so a team of two or more needs Pro.

## What Does a Production App on Render Cost?

Three worked examples, using the list prices above (no bandwidth overage): [...] > TL;DR: Hobby is $0 + compute (1 seat, 25 services, 5 GB bandwidth). Pro is $25/month + compute (unlimited seats, 25 GB). Scale is $499/month + compute (multiple workspaces, SAML SSO, 1 TB). Web services cost $0 (Free, sleeps), then $7/month for 512 MB and $25/month for 2 GB. Postgres starts at $6/month. Upgrading the workspace plan does not stop a Free service from sleeping — moving the service to a paid instance does, on any plan.

## What Are Render's Workspace Plans in 2026? [...] No. Since April 2026, Pro is $25/month flat per workspace with unlimited seats, plus compute. It replaced the per-member Professional plan ($19 per member). Scale ($499/month flat) replaced Organization ($29 per member).

results.title: Render Pricing 2026: Pro $25 + Compute, 3 Real Bills
results.snippet:
Two parts: a workspace plan (Hobby $0, Pro $25, Scale $499 a month, per Render's pricing page read November 16, 2026) plus a fixed monthly price for each service. The smallest paid web service is $7 (512 MB) and the smallest paid Postgres is $6 (256 MB), so a small app runs about $13 a month on Hobby.

### Is Render Pro $25 per user?

No. Render lists Pro at $25 a month plus compute, with unlimited seats and services. You pay the $25 once for the workspace, then pay for each service you run. [...] Quick Answer

Render charges you twice: a workspace plan (Hobby $0, Pro $25, Scale $499 a month) and a fixed monthly price for every service you run. The smallest paid web service is $7 and the smallest paid Postgres is $6, so a small app costs about $13 a month. An app with a background worker and a 1 GB database is about $33, and a team app on Pro with Redis about $107. [...] Bandwidth past the included amount is $0.15 per GB. Persistent disks are $0.25 per GB a month. Pro's $25 is per workspace, not per seat.

Workspace plan. Pro ($25/month) unlocks autoscaling, full-stack previews, and more included bandwidth. Scale ($499/month) adds SSO, SCIM, HIPAA eligibility, and organization-level controls.

## Cost optimization

### Right-size instances [...] 1. List every service: web, worker, Postgres, Key Value, cron, workflows, disks.
2. Look up each instance type on Render pricing.
3. For always-on services, use the monthly rate. For cron and workflows, estimate runtime and multiply by the per-minute or per-hour rate.
4. Add Postgres storage (GB × $0.30) and disk storage (GB × $0.25).
5. Add your workspace plan fee ($0 on Hobby, $25 on Pro, $499 on Scale).
6. Estimate outbound GB beyond your plan's included bandwidth (× $0.15).
